mission: Make the Android phone the sovereign deterministic Home Center control plane: persist state and scheduling locally, continue useful work offline, orchestrate local/browser/Gemini/fleet/cloud capability only through explicit adapters, and use Ollama only as a gated fallback classifier when deterministic routing cannot resolve a task.
constraints: phone is sovereign control plane; cloud is optional muscle
Termux is execution substrate, not the primary UX
Fish/Python deterministic compiler remains the execution grammar
behavior and controls evolve primarily through config
offline local jobs continue; network jobs defer durably
Ollama disabled by default and never used as scheduler or execution truth
no raw shell hidden behind natural-language commands
no silent cloud escalation or paid fallback
browser/Gemini/fleet outputs require deterministic artifact verification
use phone compute aggressively but thermally humanely
keep requested, implemented, tested, deployed, callable, delivered, and accepted distinct
physical phone receipts are required for phone deployment acceptance
wireless debugging may remain enabled continuously when it provides a durable trusted phone-laptop control network; do not optimize it away merely for CPU/power neatness
Fortress Bridge should prefer a persistent trusted-WLAN bootstrap relationship and automatic recovery whenever Android-authorized state permits it
after reboot or Android revocation, any physical action requirement must be represented explicitly as managed bridge state rather than an unexplained rish traceback
daemon means observe -> compare -> decide -> act if warranted -> verify -> persist -> sleep/backoff -> observe; unchanged state must sleep rather than poll or narrate
